description: Cost: free. Create a spending policy for an AI agent. Sets rules the agent must follow before any financial action: per-transaction ceiling, daily limit, hold threshold, blocked counterparties, allowed purposes, oracle stability gate. Once set, every payment by this agent is checked against the policy automatically via policy.check.

agent_id.description: Stable identifier for the agent or org (wallet address, session prefix, org slug, etc.)

allowed_purposes.description: If set, only payments with a purpose in this list are allowed.

blocked_counterparties.description: Wallet addresses or LEIs to block.

blocked_regions.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes to block.

max_per_day.description: USD rolling daily ceiling. Payments that would exceed this are HOLDed.

max_per_tx.description: USD ceiling per single transaction. Payments above this are BLOCKED.

require_hold_above.description: Route to HOLD queue for human review if amount exceeds this threshold.

require_oracle_stable.description: If true, HOLD on CAUTION as well as UNSTABLE oracle status.

wallet_nonce.description: Single-use nonce used in the signed message.

wallet_signature.description:
EIP-191 signature from agent_id (must be a wallet address) over "METHOD
PATH
SHA256(BODY)
TIMESTAMP_MS
NONCE", where BODY is JSON.stringify of these arguments without the wallet_* fields. Required unless the operator uses an admin key.

wallet_timestamp.description: Milliseconds since epoch used in the signed message (±5 min).

name: policy.create
